title: From vision to a place to call home.
subtitle: A chaptered architectural film: from construction to waterfront living.
alt: Generated waterfront tower concept with a landscaped approach and bronze entrance canopy

chapters.title: Build to opening
chapters.summary: An accelerated architectural concept sequence moves from early structure to the finished tower and landscaped opening.
chapters.continuity: Same tower silhouette, footprint, shoreline and approach. Do not morph a different building into the final structure.

chapters.title: Landscape & arrival
chapters.summary: A gentle landscape reveal establishes the reflecting pool, promenade and bronze-framed entrance before the interior cut.
chapters.continuity: The landscape shot establishes the entrance; an editorial cut moves inside. It does not depict walking through the pool or glass.

chapters.title: Lobby & lift
chapters.summary: Explore the double-height limestone lobby and its bronze lift bank along a clear floor aisle.
chapters.continuity: Repeat entrance fins, limestone floor and pool sightline. Follow an unobstructed floor path; no camera passing through furniture or walls.

chapters.title: Residence & view
chapters.summary: A clear editorial cut bridges the change of floor, revealing an open residence and the waterfront beyond.
chapters.continuity: Bronze, limestone and warm daylight continue across a deliberate cut to the apartment entry. No continuous lift ride or surveyed floor plan is implied.

title: Arrive. Unwind. Feel at home.
subtitle: A short architectural film from a welcoming lobby to a sea-view suite.
alt: Generated boutique hotel lobby with limestone reception, seafoam seating and a bronze lift bank to the right

chapters.title: Lobby & arrival
chapters.summary: A gentle approach passes the seafoam lounge and limestone reception toward the bronze lift bank.
chapters.continuity: Pale limestone, oak ceiling fins, seafoam seating and the courtyard tree stay in their reference positions. Keep the guest walking line clear.

chapters.title: Suite & terrace
chapters.summary: After a deliberate room-entry cut, explore the oak-and-sage suite and its open sea-view terrace.
chapters.continuity: Continue the same limestone, oak and bronze palette. The corridor leads naturally through one room door; keep the bed, window and terrace fixed throughout the shot.
